summary: Pharvaris N.V. filed a Form 6-K reporting an underwritten public offering of 4,455,863 ordinary shares at $29.68 per share, including underwriters' option exercise. The offering closed on May 11, 2026, raising approximately $124 million net proceeds. Proceeds will fund R&D for late-stage clinical programs, U.S. sales and marketing expansion, and general corporate purposes. The offering was conducted under an effective F-3ASR shelf registration. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. No special-situation category applies.
